source: Executable rules in src/replicate_omb_original.py (this JSON is a human-readable crosswalk, not separate executable logic)
units: Each reported inventory row, not independent physical AI deployments

code_meanings.L: Appeal Precluded by Law shorthand; official option covers law, operational limitations or governmentwide guidance
code_meanings.O: Consultation only Other, no substantive detail
code_meanings.M: Consultation list with multiple code types
code_meanings.W: CAIO Waived (defined in code, not observed in selected 227 rows)

strict.consultation: Use Python ast.literal_eval, map list elements to codes; U empty; X unknown/invalid; M if different codes occur; otherwise single code

ordered_conditions.if: contains Not Applicable OR Precluded by Law (any field)
starts with Yes, CAIO Review, Internal Independent Review, Oversight Board Review, Training Established, Appeal Process Established or ['

broad.note: Broad uses generic text matching and does not establish the answer is appropriate to the question. Some X/M values can become P/E. No per-row manual overrides.

comparison: Two rows match iff eight code characters are equal (same field order). Counts use n*(n-1)//2 unordered pairs; proportions use N*(N-1)//2.
audit_note: Strict groups different positive consultation and review options into E, and all mixed consultation status types into M. Original raw distinctions remain in official CSV.
